Channing Capital Management LLC Has $8.73 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Donald Scott | Feb 19th, 2018 
Channing Capital Management LLC trimmed its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.9% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 56,641 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 6,903 shares during the quarter. Channing Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,730,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
Other large investors have also recently made changes to their positions in the company. Middleton & Co Inc MA grew its holdings in Apple by 21.0% in the third quarter. Middleton & Co Inc MA now owns 128,013 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $19,729,000 after purchasing an additional 22,207 shares during the period. Concorde Asset Management LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 64.4% in the third quarter. Concorde Asset Management LLC now owns 6,862 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,058,000 after purchasing an additional 2,689 shares during the period. Savant Capital LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 1.7% in the third quarter. Savant Capital LLC now owns 43,369 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,684,000 after purchasing an additional 717 shares during the period. Villere ST Denis J & Co. LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 0.7% in the third quarter. Villere ST Denis J & Co. LLC now owns 60,538 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,330,000 after purchasing an additional 405 shares during the period. Finally, Palisade Capital Management LLC NJ grew its holdings in Apple by 3.7% in the third quarter. Palisade Capital Management LLC NJ now owns 168,419 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,957,000 after purchasing an additional 6,069 shares during the period. Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded down $0.56 during midday trading on Monday, hitting $172.43. The company had a trading volume of 39,638,793 shares, compared to its average volume of 41,970,000. The firm has a market cap of $874,910.00, a PE ratio of 16.87, a PEG ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $135.10 and a 1 year high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.46 EPS for the current year. 
The company also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th were given a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.46%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 24.66%. 
A number of analysts have recently issued reports on AAPL shares. UBS Group reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 23rd. Royal Bank of Canada reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 23rd. Drexel Hamilton reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 30th. Maxim Group reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $193.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, October 27th. Finally, started coverage on Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 25th. They issued a “buy” rating and a $193.00 price target on the stock. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.64.

The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this link . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 10,368 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, November 24th. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 81,560 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $14,246,900.80. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last three months, insiders sold 112,771 shares of company stock valued at $19,419,429. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
